name: bonanza-mcp
description: Bonanza (ecommerce channels): me, create_listing, end_listing, list_orders, mark_shipped. Every tool

platform_mcp_bonanza_dev_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BONANZA_DEV_ID
platform_mcp_bonanza_dev_id.description: Developer id (dev_id) of your approved Bonanza API account (api.bonanza.com > Apply for an API account); sent as the X-BONANZLE-API-DEV-NAME header.

platform_mcp_bonanza_cert_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BONANZA_CERT_ID
platform_mcp_bonanza_cert_id.description: Certificate id (cert_id) of the same API account; sent as the X-BONANZLE-API-CERT-NAME header.

platform_mcp_bonanza_auth_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BONANZA_AUTH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_bonanza_auth_token.description: The seller's verified user token (fetchToken, then the seller approves it at the returned authentication URL); sent in every request body as requesterCredentials.bonanzleAuthToken. Tokens expire a year after issue or when the seller deactivates them.

tools.name: me
tools.description: getTokenStatus returns getTokenStatusResponse {verified, hardExpirationTime} for the configured seller token.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: addFixedPriceItem with allowForSale=true: the item is PUBLISHED for sale in the seller's booth immediately when it has every required field (sellingState Active). `price` is in US dollars; title at most 80 characters; up to 4 image URLs fetched by Bonanza. Category is guessed by Bonanza and no shipping is sent, so an item without a shipping setting comes back as 'Missing required fields' with the missing fields in raw.message. `currency` is not a field of the call.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: endFixedPriceItem removes the item from the seller's booth; endFixedPriceItemResponse.itemsRemoved (in raw) is the number actually removed (0 means nothing was ended).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: getOrders as seller: orderStatus (Active|Cancelled|Completed|Incomplete|InProcess|Invoiced|Proposed|Shipped; Completed = paid, not yet shipped), createTimeFrom (dateTime), entriesPerPage (max 100) and pageNumber (max 100). Each row is orderArray[].order; `total` is order.total (a decimal string, US dollars), items and shipping address in raw.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: completeSale {transactionID (= order id), shipped: true, shipment {shippingTrackingNumber, shippingCarrierUsed}} marks the order shipped. `carrier` must be one of usps, ups, fedex, other.
